**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of ribosome biogenesis in these distinct diseases could reveal common therapeutic targets for improving protein synthesis or cellular resilience in both hematologic and cardiac conditions. Strategies aimed at enhancing ribosome function or mitigating the consequences of ribosomal dysfunction might have cross-disease applicability.
